paragraphs: Oliva LLC is recalling approximately 250 units of Riad's Oliva to Go Baba Ghanouj, Spicy Baba Ghanouj, and Hummus because they may contain undeclared sesame, which poses a serious or life-threatening risk to people with sesame allergies [4]. Pan Pepin Inc. is recalling certain lots of Para Bien Al Grano due to undeclared sesame [2]. Krasnyi Oktyabr Inc. of Brooklyn, New York is recalling Starfish Seafood Trio – Cold Smoked Salmon, Halibut, and Trout (8 oz packages) because the product may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes, which can cause serious and sometimes fatal infections [5]. Gardeners Basics of Spanish Fork, Utah is recalling one-pound bags of Waltham 29 Broccoli Sprouting Seeds due to possible Salmonella contamination, which can cause serious infections in young children, elderly people, and others with weakened immune systems [6].
